note: Authored from docs/spec; expected facts are derived by tools/fixtures/movement, not by packages/core. No state or draw hashes: later entries assert those.
tick: 60 Hz fixed; phases input, waits, threads, movement, edges, triggers, animation (AD-26)
units: board pixels; fractions are exact multiples of 1/256

cases.name: pause-thread-flag-waits-for-completion
cases.note: tkMV_PAUSE_THREAD: the thread parks on a movement wait; the wait is polled in the `waits` phase, so it resumes on the tick after the movement finishes and then reads the by-reference location.

cases.name: without-the-flag-the-thread-continues
cases.note: Without the flag the path runs concurrently: the thread emits at once, sleeps 10 ticks and wakes while the item is still walking.

cases.name: blocking-thread-implies-the-wait
cases.note: Movement started from a blocking program runs to completion before the program continues (E-33), with no flag.

cases.name: multirun-one-wait-over-both-sprites
cases.note: multiRun defers every start, then yields one movement wait over the collected sprites: the thread resumes after the slower sprite finishes.

cases.name: waypoint-path-copy-two-cycles
cases.note: tkMV_WAYPOINT_PATH copies the vector; cycles = 2 walks it twice then completes and releases the pause.

cases.name: waypoint-link-sees-live-edit
cases.note: tkMV_WAYPOINT_LINK reads the vector live: moving the second point at tick 12 changes the route from the next segment on.
